about: Requests a coding agent gets, each with the tool goal it needs and a pattern an acceptable tool's name, title or description matches (case-insensitive). Scored by scripts/eval_tool_coding.py: goal accuracy, hit@5, MRR. Patterns name capabilities, not one product, so the set stays valid as the registry changes.
